_doc: Single source of truth shared by mechanical/puck.py, mechanical/blender and hardware/gen_pcb.py. Units mm. Board coordinates: origin on the puck axis, +x right, +y up, viewed from the cap (top). z = 0 at the plate face that seats on the Avalon weight.

puck.plate: 6061-T6 flat plate, laser or waterjet cut: centre hole for the bolt, 3x M2 tapped
puck.gasket: die-cut 0.5 mm silicone ring under the cap wall, ~0.3 mm compressed
puck.screw: M2x8 cheese head (ISO 14580, Torx) from above, through the cap, PCB and standoff into the tapped plate

_pcb_dia: Puck OD = Avalon barebow weight OD (40 mm). Cavity 37 mm (cap_wall 1.5) minus 0.5 mm clearance per side.

bosses._positions: Board x, y. H2, H3 and H4 at r = 16.5 (160, 305 and 226 deg). H1 at (9.2, 1.2): right of the tube, below the antenna zone (its copper keep-out ring ends 0.9 mm below it), where C1/D1/D3 used to be, so it holds the board's top half. H4 holds the left arm (PCM and cell contacts), which had no screw below H2. Four screws for shot shock (README D29).
bosses._screw: The counterbore depth puts the screw tip tip_inset above the plate's underside, so it never touches the weight.

cell.part: LIR1254 Li-ion coin cell, plain (no tabs), 3.6-3.7 V, 45-65 mAh
cell._swell: No swell spec for LIR cells: 1.2 mm free above the 5.4 mm cell (Varta asks 1.5 mm for its cells), set so the connector is flush with the cap top. The cap's foam pad fills it and clamps the cell.
cell._contacts: + : spring contact from pos_pad against the can side. - : strap from neg_pad across the top cap, Kapton where it passes the can. The cap's foam pad presses the strap and the cell onto the Kapton on the plate.

module._rot: Long axis tangential above the sleeve; antenna end (the footprint's -x end, turned 180 deg) points to +x, copper-free from there to the rim. Centred on x = 0 as high as it goes: both top corners 0.24 mm inside the rim (more than the 0.2 mm outline tolerance), body 0.9 mm above the tube. The antenna zone's corner toward the tube is chamfered (board_shape.ANTENNA_CHAMFER), leaving a 0.83 mm copper passage between it and the tube hole. mass_g is an estimate (not in the data sheet): weigh the part.

connector.part: Samzo PR5L4015-2P-C-F magnetic receptacle (Electrokit 41035992); cable side PR5L5015-2P-C-H (Electrokit 41035991)
connector._note: Samzo drawing GZ0254-P001. Mounted on the PCB; puck.pcb_standoff puts its top flush with the cap top, which has an opening around it (RTV seal). mass_g is an estimate: weigh the part.
connector._body: Stepped (Samzo GZ0254-P001): a 12.5 mm long top boss (2 mm) on a 14.5 mm flange (2 mm), both 4 mm wide with round ends. The cap opening fits the boss; a lip under the cap top stops 0.1 mm above the flange ends (RTV in the gap), so the cap, not the solder joints, takes the plug's pull.

bolt.head: button head socket cap screw, 3/16 in hex
bolt._note: The Avalon weight bolt as a button head, longer by the puck height plus the sealing washer: it goes through the cap top, the sleeve and the weight into the riser. Bonded sealing washer under the head.

sleeve._note: One loose tube from the plate through the Kapton and the PCB to the underside of the cap top, where a lip under the cap locates it; the plate and the cap trap it, so it cannot fall out. The bolt clamps the PC cap top onto the tube: PC is in the clamp path (Richard's prototype test, README D21). The PCB hole (od + 2 x pcb_clear) is merged with the cell notch by a straight slot; the right half of the board reaches the rest only across the top. The tube can turn, so the Kapton tape goes all round it from the plate to the cell top.

standoffs.part: M2 round spacer, 3 mm long, OD 4 mm, aluminium
standoffs._note: One under the PCB at each screw; OD within the copper-free boss ring (3.8 + 2 x 0.3 mm) on both layers.
